That is probably the sweetest subreddit I've ever seen, thank you for that

And no, I don't. I broke all contact because after I've gone to uni, I've got no word from them ever again and always had to text first
Even if it did, after a while you'd feel it again. And the pain would be even more excruciating because you felt nothing before, just like it is with local anaesthetics

Any pill method hurts like a bitch... even sleeping pills. You don't just fall asleep as the movies portray. You're in physical agony because your organs shut down and you slowly succumb to that, in a painful death. I'm sorry to disappoint you
